load_sqa3d: load SQA3D dataset by merging questions and annotations JSON files with ScanNet scene data
get_sqa3d_meta: get SQA3D dataset metadata including category IDs and class names from a name map
register_sqa3d: register SQA3D train, val, and test datasets with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
test_load_sqa3d: test the load_sqa3d function with questions and annotations JSON file paths
review_register_sqa3d: review the register_sqa3d function that registers SQA3D splits with Detectron2
